objective: Recruit a diverse, consent-aware multiplayer test cohort for QA-approved GameDeck route tuples without claiming universal compatibility or collecting unnecessary personal data.

conditions: The exact public claim names only QA-approved route tuples.
The call to action resolves to the repository multiplayer session issue template.
The privacy warning is included without weakening it.
Footage, account changes, paid promotion, and external publication require separate approval.
Unknown coverage and response counts remain unknown rather than becoming zero or success claims.

cohortDimensions.collection: OS family and coarse version only
Selected route and public reason code; never collect public IP addresses
Topology and controller family; exact model is optional
Family and wired or wireless connection only
Coarse comparison only; never collect city, address, coordinates, or IP data
Display mode and optional coarse resolution

allowedReportFields: host, guest, both-sides, or same-device role
game system and emulator or core
first failing step or stable public reason code
whether the result reproduced after restart
optional consent to GitHub username credit
proofChecklist: Name the exact GameDeck commit or release.
Name the tested route, host or guest role, OS family, controller topology, game system, and engine or core.
Record the first failing step or completed-play outcome.
Record one stable public reason and one repair action when blocked.
Use duration bands instead of exact behavioral timelines.
Sanitize diagnostics and confirm forbidden data is absent.
Treat one successful tuple as evidence for that tuple only.
Obtain explicit consent before crediting a tester or reusing footage.

allowed: GameDeck is recruiting testers for specifically named QA-approved routes.
Each report adds evidence for one exact environment tuple.
GameDeck requires legally owned game content and does not distribute games, BIOS files, keys, or saves.
forbidden: Every emulator, controller, operating system, or network is supported.
Testing proves zero-latency or failure-free play.
Privacy is guaranteed regardless of external platforms or peers.

measurement.source: Public GitHub issue metadata and explicitly submitted reports only
measurement.smallCellPolicy: Do not publish segmented rates below the privacy-safe multiplayer metrics contract minimum cohort.
measurement.responseState: unknown until an approved recruitment message is published and observed

stopConditions: Pause recruitment if the CTA is broken or routes to an unreviewed surface.
Pause recruitment if reports expose private data or copyrighted game content.
Withdraw any claim that exceeds the exact QA evidence named at publication.
Do not spend money, promise rewards, or contact testers privately without separate authorization.
